name: The same marks on text with an emoji
description: The same lines over text with an emoji. An emoji is one character for the user but two for Java, so a mark next to it checks that positions are counted correctly.
descriptionHtml:
The same lines over text with an emoji. An emoji is one character for the user but two for Java, so a mark next to it checks that positions are counted correctly.

Manual run: 📋 Copy application.Samples.Form.RichTextOnFormTest#markCombinationsOverEmoji into GitHub Actions → Run Workflow → include PATH
